tests.title: Inventory history shows matching stock movements
tests.goal: A CRM user can find audit records for a selected product movement.
preconditions: At least one inventory movement exists for an active staging product.
data: Product name, SKU, or barcode of an existing item.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open Inventory History.
Search for a product name, SKU, or barcode that has an existing movement.
Review the movement type, warehouse, related lot/order reference, date, and staff fields.

expected.text: The results relate to the selected product.
Each movement shows its type, warehouse, reference where available, date, and staff.
No history record is edited or deleted.
